title: Natural Disasters
description: Senior-high English unit on reading the signs of natural disasters; teaching materials generated in Chinese.

discovery_answers.unit_theme: 自然灾害——读懂大地的信号
discovery_answers.student_context: 高一学生，英语阅读能力中等，中文思维理解灾难话题更快，需以中文讲授降低语言门槛
discovery_answers.teaching_objectives: 理解地震、洪水、台风、干旱四类灾害的成因与应对；掌握灾害主题英语词汇；能就防灾准备用英语进行简单表达
discovery_answers.material_positioning: 自编合成单元（主题语境对应人教版高中英语必修第一册 Unit 4 Natural Disasters）

planning_answers.period_plan: 共6课时，每课2课时，评估聚焦灾害应对方案的中文说明与英文关键词表达

expected_evidence_direction.criterion_notes: All seven intent fields are stated in the teacher-intent source; artifacts should carry Chinese teaching copy while exercise content keeps English key terms.
expected_evidence_direction.coverage_focus: Disaster-response vocabulary and safety procedures from the reading passage should be traceable into exercises.
